connectorUiConfig.title: Armis Audit Logs (via Codeless Connector Framework)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: The [Armis](https://www.armis.com/) Audit Logs data connector enables you to ingest audit logs from your Armis instance into Microsoft Sentinel through the Armis REST API using the Codeless Connector Framework (CCF). The connector polls for new audit logs every 15 minutes.

sampleQueries.description: Get a sample of Armis Audit Logs

dataTypes.name: ArmisAuditLog_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
ArmisAuditLog_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and Write permissions are required.

customs.name: Armis Secret Key
customs.description: An Armis API secret key, created in Armis under Settings -> API Management.

instructionSteps.title: STEP 1 - Configuration steps for the Armis API
instructionSteps.description: Follow these instructions to create an Armis API secret key.

parameters.content:
1. Log into your Armis instance
2. Navigate to **Settings -> API Management**
3. If the secret key has not already been created, press the **Create** button to create the secret key
4. To access the secret key, press the **Show** button
5. The secret key can now be copied and used during the Armis Audit Logs connector configuration

instructionSteps.title: STEP 2 - Connect Armis Audit Logs to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description:
Provide the following details to start collecting Armis audit logs:

1. **Armis Base URL** - The URL of your Armis instance, for example `https://your-tenant.armis.com`, without a trailing slash.
2. **Armis Secret Key** - The API secret key created in STEP 1.

parameters.label: Armis Base URL
parameters.placeholder: Enter your Armis instance URL (e.g. https://your-tenant.armis.com)
parameters.name: armisBaseUrl

instructionSteps.title: STEP 3 - Validate data collection
instructionSteps.description: Confirm that Armis audit logs are flowing into Microsoft Sentinel.

parameters.content:
1. **Check the connection status**: Once connected, the connector shows as **Connected** on this page.
2. **Validate the data**: Use the sample queries on this page to confirm that audit logs are being received. The connector polls every 15 minutes, so the first logs can take a few minutes to appear.
